title: lithocarpus elaeagnifolius
intro: Lithocarpus elaeagnifolius, commonly known as Lithocarpus or Burmese Lithocarpus, is a plant species belonging to the beech family (Fagaceae). It is traditionally used in medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, thereby aiding in the treatment of various ailments such as fever, skin diseases, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Lithocarpus elaeagnifolius include its ability to act as an anti-oxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial agent, and it is also used as a treatment for fever, skin diseases, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
